-y &= -4x-3 \\
y &= 4x+3
\end{aligned}
$$

$$
\begin{aligned}

-12x-9y=18 &\quad\Longrightarrow\quad y=-\frac{4}{3}x-2 \\
6x+2y=-6 &\quad\Longrightarrow\quad y=-3x-3 \\
8x-2y=4 &\quad\Longrightarrow\quad y=4x-2
\end{aligned}
$$

The line $-12x+3y=9$ has both the same slope $4$ and the same $y$-intercept $3$ as the given line. It is the same line, so it is not a distinct parallel line.

8x-2y=4
